blocks.t: This is the Comparison Trap.
blocks.h: This is the Comparison Trap.

blocks.t: It is one of the great injustices of being a twelve-year-old in this particular decade. Comparison has always existed. Adolescents have always compared themselves to other adolescents. The new thing — the thing that is novel, in human history — is that the comparison set is now infinite. You are no longer comparing yourself to the thirty kids in your class. You are comparing yourself to every twelve-year-old on planet Earth who has chosen to perform a version of themselves, professionally and with good lighting, on a platform designed by adults to maximize the amount of time you spend looking at it.
